en.headline: Government prioritises public transport at Huanggang for Halloween weekend peak
en.dek: Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said northbound departures from 11pm to 2am from Friday will be the busiest period, with private cars potentially facing waits of over an hour.
body: The government expects the late-night hours from 11pm to 2am from Friday to be the peak for northbound passenger and vehicle traffic at the new Huanggang Port over the Halloween weekend, Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki said on Wednesday.

Chan said the combination of Halloween events, the Wine and Dine Festival at the Central Harbourfront and concerts at Kai Tak Sports Park is expected to drive a significant increase in visitors and cross-boundary travel. Authorities will adopt a public-transport-first principle, prioritising franchised buses, green minibuses and cross-boundary coaches.

He noted that road capacity connecting the port and the processing capacity for private cars have limits. Last weekend's late-night surge saw nearly 1,000 private cars northbound in two hours, requiring the vehicle buffer zone and leading to longer queues. Chan warned that private car waiting times in the buffer zone and inspection channels could exceed one hour during the peak.

Chan urged travellers to avoid concentrating departures in the late-night window, to use other ports where possible, to choose public transport, or to stay overnight in Hong Kong. He also said police and the Transport Department would take firm action against unlicensed cross-boundary vehicles.

zh.headline: 政府料萬聖節周末深宵皇崗北行最繁忙 公共交通優先放行
zh.dek: 政務司司長陳國基表示，周五起一連三日晚上11時至凌晨2時將是新皇崗口岸北行出境高峰，私家車輪候或超過一小時。
body: 政務司司長陳國基周三表示，預計本周末萬聖節加上中環海濱美酒佳餚巡禮及啟德演唱會，訪港旅客及深宵跨境出行將顯著增加，周五起一連三日晚上11時至翼日凌晨2時將是新皇崗口岸北行出境人流及車流最繁忙時段。
當局將採取公共交通優先原則，保障專營巴士、專線小巴及跨境巴士暢順通行。陳國基指，連接口岸的道路容量及私家車處理能力有上限，上周末凌晨兩小時內已有近1000架次私家車北上，需開放車輛緩衝區，導致輪候時間延長。
他預告深宵高峰時段跨境私家車在緩衝區及車檢通道的輪候時間可能至少超過一小時，並已指示警方及運輸署嚴厲打擊跨境白牌車。口岸部門會提早開放所有車道、自助通道及櫃台，與內地緊密對接。
陳國基呼籲旅客避免集中深宵時段過關，善用其他口岸，選擇公共交通或留港過夜，以將輪候時間減至最低。他強調現時口岸處理能力整體未超出上限，但個別時段會超過負荷。
